texts.passenger_random_0: What a beautiful day for a trip!
texts.passenger_random_1: I hope the journey will be comfortable and pleasant.
texts.passenger_random_2: Wonder what adventures await me ahead?
texts.passenger_random_3: I've always dreamed of visiting new places by train.
texts.passenger_random_4: I love the sound of wheels on the rails—it's so soothing.
texts.passenger_random_5: Did someone steal your sweet roll?
texts.anecdote_0_0: A patient walks into the doctor's and says
texts.shopkeeper_rich_random_0: Oh, the lord arrived in his fancy ride? Take whatever you want, just don't jingle your coins
texts.shopkeeper_rich_random_1: For folks like you, I've got champagne at airplane prices. Can you even afford it?
texts.shopkeeper_rich_random_2: Your Excellency, a pack of smokes? Or do you prefer gold ones with diamonds?
texts.shopkeeper_rich_random_3: Rich guy, pour some from your wallet for me too—I'm scraping by on pennies here
texts.shopkeeper_rich_random_4: Millionaire, don't multiply around here, pay up and head back to your mansion
texts.shopkeeper_poor_random_0: You again, you bum? Stop begging for pennies, go get a job
texts.shopkeeper_poor_random_1: Hobo, can't even scrape together bread money? Get outta here, don't stink up the place
texts.shopkeeper_poor_random_2: Five rubles? With that budget, dig in the dumpster, loser
texts.shopkeeper_poor_random_3: Another starving wretch. We don't give freebies—go beg for alms
texts.shopkeeper_poor_random_4: My poor fellow, have you ever looked in a mirror? Pay up or scram
texts.lose_header: You've been kicked off the train. Now your adventure leads you under a bridge, where you'll die stoned.
texts.win_header: You have come a long way and have finally arrived at the final station!
